# Wrapped ETH

> Wrapped ETH is ether locked in a contract and reissued as an ERC-20 token, so any dapp can transfer, approve, and trade it.

## Key facts
- Token: WETH — an ERC-20 token (18 decimals) representing ether
- Backing / peg: 1:1 — each unit is redeemable through the contract for one ETH
- Convert: Wrap via the contract's deposit(), unwrap via withdraw(), or trade on a DEX
- Networks: Canonical WETH9 exists on Ethereum Mainnet (chain ID 1); other chains use separate contracts
- Costs: Ethereum gas only on wrap/unwrap; pool fee plus price impact on a DEX swap
- Verify: Check the contract address, not the ticker
